name: Downtown Farmers & Artisans Market
description: Weekly open-air marketplace featuring over 50 local farmers, organic produce growers, bakeries, and handcrafted artisan goods. Live acoustic music and composting demonstrations.

name: Summer Park Jazz Concert Series
description: An evening of smooth jazz, funk, and modern swing featuring the Greenfield All-Stars Big Band and guest soloists. Lawn seating available; picnic blankets and folding chairs welcome.

name: City Marathon
description: Annual 26.2-mile road marathon and 10K community run traversing historic downtown, scenic riverfront corridors, and finishing at Central Park Grand Pavilion. Hydration stations every 2 miles.

name: Greenfield Cultural Heritage & Arts Festival
description: A vibrant celebration of multicultural traditions featuring international dance performances, traditional craft workshops, authentic global culinary kiosks, and interactive folklore storytelling.

name: Riverside Food Truck Extravaganza
description: Over 25 regional food trucks gathering along the waterfront serving gourmet burgers, wood-fired pizza, Asian street delicacies, vegan desserts, and local craft beverages.

name: Greenfield Tech & Smart City Innovation Expo
location: Greenfield Convention Center, Hall A & B
description: Showcasing regional technology startups, AI innovations, clean energy solutions, and municipal digital governance projects. Includes keynote panels and student robotics showcases.
organizer: Greenfield Innovation Alliance & Chamber of Commerce

name: River Clean-up & Arbor Volunteer Planting Day
description: Community volunteer morning to remove debris along 4 miles of the Green River corridor and plant 200 native saplings. Gloves, trash grabbers, tools, and volunteer refreshments provided.

name: Youth Soccer Autumn Invitational Tournament
description: Regional youth soccer tournament featuring 32 under-14 teams from surrounding counties. Concession stands, medal ceremonies, and youth sportsmanship awards.

name: Shakespeare in the Park: A Midsummer Night's Dream
description: Free community theatrical performance by the Greenfield Repertory Players under the evening stars. Bring blankets; hot cider and light snacks available for purchase.

name: Greenfield Autumn Harvest Fair & Pumpkin Fest
description: Family-friendly festival with giant pumpkin carving contests, cider pressing, hayrides, petting zoo, face painting, and costume parade for children and pets.

name: Senior Health, Wellness & Flu Vaccination Clinic
location: Greenfield Senior Activity Center, Elm Hall
description: Free annual flu vaccinations, blood pressure and glucose screenings, hearing checks, and wellness consultations provided by Greenfield Hospital clinical nurses.

name: Historic Downtown Walking & Architecture Tour
location: Old City Hall Steps, 100 Heritage Square
description: Guided walking tour led by the Greenfield Historical Preservation Society exploring 19th-century Victorian brick architecture, underground tunnels, and pioneer heritage.

name: Bicycle Commuter Day & Community Ride Along
description: Celebration of sustainable urban transit. Free bicycle tune-ups, helmet checks, route maps, complimentary coffee and pastries for bike commuters.
organizer: Greenfield Department of Transportation & Bike Coalition

name: Greenfield Open Air Cinema: Classic Movie Under the Stars
description: Screening of family classic movies on a 40-foot inflatable outdoor cinema screen. Free popcorn courtesy of Greenfield Parks Bureau.

name: Winter Holiday Lights Parade & Tree Lighting Ceremony
location: Civic Center Plaza & City Hall Square
description: Spectacular illuminated floats, high school marching bands, community carolers, and the ceremonial lighting of the 50-foot city spruce tree by the Mayor.

name: Municipal Public Budget Town Hall
location: City Council Chambers, 3rd Floor Civic Center
description: Open public forum to review Greenfield Municipal Corporation fiscal year operating budget, infrastructure priorities, and citizen public questions.
organizer: Greenfield City Council & City Manager Office
